governance.description: Expert-driven only. No quantitative player-prop model impact. Recommendations require a current-week direction and an explicit quoted threshold; sportsbook availability and final inactives must be rechecked before execution.
governance.staleDataPolicy: Completed-game recommendations are archived automatically and cannot remain actionable.
governance.injuryGate: Monday final inactives remain pending. Every recommendation is conditional on the cited player being active and the listed price threshold remaining available.
